entity_types.name: Event
entity_types.definition: A scheduled campus or campus-affiliated happening (talk, workshop, performance, study break, or market) with one or more time slots.

fields.name: title
fields.verification: Match the primary event heading on static_html pages (stripping site chrome suffixes such as '| NYU Steinhardt' or '- LibCal - NYU Libraries'), LiveWhale 'title', or Bedework 'summary'.

fields.name: university
fields.verification: Confirm the source URL domain (*.nyu.edu or nyu.libcal.com -> 'NYU'; *.columbia.edu -> 'Columbia') and institutional header on the page.

fields.name: description
fields.verification: Confirm every sentence appears in the event's body copy (static_html) or 'summary'/'description' fields (json_feed) after HTML-entity decoding, excluding disability boilerplate, equal-opportunity footers, and registration form prompts.

fields.name: sessions
fields.verification: Verify each slot's date, start time, optional end time (null in nyu-15), and America/New_York offset against 'date_iso'/'date2_iso' (LiveWhale), 'start_utcdate'/'end_utcdate' (Bedework), or explicit Date/Time text. If the body omits the year (nyu-02, nyu-17), verify the year from the URL path (e.g. '/2026-11/') cross-checked against the stated weekday ('Sun, November 22'); if no year exists in text or URL (col-07), flag as unverified until resolved.

fields.name: modality
fields.verification: Verify 'online' from an explicit online location ('Online Online' in col-03) and virtual join prose; verify 'in_person' from a physical venue/room or 'In-Person' badge. On NYU LibCal pages (nyu-07, nyu-10, nyu-12), ignore the canned registration form disclaimer 'Please note this is an online event' when the top badge says 'In-Person' and a physical library room is listed.

fields.name: location_detail
fields.verification: Match the exact floor, room number, lounge, suite, or gate entrance text inside the venue on the source page (e.g. 'Room 570', '6th Floor, Rm. 619', 'Lehman Suite, IAB Room 406').

fields.name: access_scope
fields.verification: Verify 'public' only when 'Open to the Public', 'General Public', or 'Events open to/Public' appears; verify 'host_university_only' when 'X-BEDEWORK-UNI-ONLY-REG: YES' is set, 'open only to the NYU community' appears, or Audience lists only internal roles ('Students, Faculty, Staff') alongside a required NetID/NYU email field.

fields.name: cost
fields.verification: Match explicit 'Cost' / 'cost' fields or prose explicitly describing event admission ('Admission is free', 'free event', 'free to attend'); do not infer event cost from descriptions of free tools (such as Zotero in col-03).

fields.name: registration_status
fields.verification: Match explicit registration statements ('Registration is required', 'Get Tickets', 'No Registration Necessary', 'not required but encouraged', 'required for campus access at NYU for external guests') or structured Bedework registration properties.

fields.name: registration_target
fields.verification: Match the external RSVP/join URL ('link' in col-01, col-03), RSVP email address ('cracscolab@gmail.com' in nyu-09), on-page registration URL (nyu-07, nyu-10, nyu-12, col-05), or named RSVP platform ('Luma' in nyu-04 when the anchor href is absent).

fields.name: capacity
fields.verification: Match the integer in 'X-BEDEWORK-MAX-TICKETS' or LibCal's 'There are N seats available.' text.

fields.name: categories
fields.verification: Match explicit 'Type', 'Event Type', 'Topic', 'Areas of Study', or Bedework 'Type/*' and 'Category/*' tags, discarding truncated strings at the end of cut-off feeds (such as 'Economic' in col-05).

fields.name: featured_people
fields.verification: Confirm each named speaker, author, performer, playwright, director, or session leader (with optional role/affiliation) appears in the event title or program description, excluding administrative staff contacts and photo credits.

fields.name: series_name
fields.verification: Match an explicit recurring series, competition, or program title stated in headings or 'About the ... Series' prose (e.g. 'TDS: COLLABORATION', 'Urban Science Research Seminar Series', 'Saturday Science').

fields.name: contact
fields.type: object<{name: string | null, email: string | null, phone: string | null}>
fields.verification: Match 'Event Organizer', 'Event Contact', 'contact_name', 'contact_phone', or contact email in the page text (normalizing ' [at] ' to '@' in nyu-04).

fields.name: sources
fields.type: array<{url: string, source_tier: string, external_id: string | null}>
fields.verification: Confirm 'url' matches the fetched page URL, 'external_id' matches LiveWhale 'id', Bedework 'guid', or LibCal URL event ID when present, and 'source_tier' follows source_tiers rules.

entity_types.name: Place
entity_types.definition: A physical campus building, library, or outdoor venue where in-person events are held.

fields.name: name
fields.verification: Match the building or outdoor venue name in 'Location', 'Location/Library', 'location_title', 'location_address', or venue prose, excluding room/floor details and never accepting 'Online Online' (col-03).

fields.name: aliases
fields.verification: Confirm every alternate name or abbreviation (e.g. 'Dibner Library' vs 'Bern Dibner Library', 'The Lee C. Bollinger Forum' vs 'The Forum at Columbia University', 'IAB' vs 'International Affairs Building') appears verbatim on a linked source page.

fields.name: university
fields.verification: Confirm campus ownership or affiliation from the university page context and campus location metadata.

fields.name: street_address
fields.verification: Match the street number, street name, and optional city/ZIP in 'Location', 'location_address', or directions prose on a cited source page.

fields.name: campus_area
fields.verification: Match an explicit campus zone tag (such as 'Location/Manhattanville' or 'Location/Morningside') or neighborhood/borough stated in the address/directions ('Brooklyn', 'Greenwich Village').

fields.name: sources
fields.type: array<{url: string, source_tier: string, external_id: string | null}>
fields.verification: Confirm 'url' matches the source page where the venue was observed and 'external_id' matches LiveWhale 'location_id' when present (nyu-05, nyu-15).

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.definition: A school, department, library, institute, campus office, student/arts collective, or external partner that hosts or co-presents events.

fields.name: name
fields.verification: Match the organization title in 'group_title', page header/breadcrumb, 'Related Departments', Bedework 'Group-Specific/*' or 'SUBMITTEDBY', or explicit hosting prose (ignoring school lists inside blank registration form dropdowns in nyu-07 and nyu-10).

fields.name: aliases
fields.verification: Confirm acronyms, short names, or calendar suite codes ('CUSP', 'CRACS Co-Lab', 'CUNO', 'ZMBBI', 'LCAH', 'TDS') appear alongside the organization on a cited source page.

fields.name: university
fields.verification: Confirm NYU or Columbia affiliation from the org's name, parent school, or campus feed group; leave null/omitted for non-university partner orgs ('Federal Election Commission' in nyu-05, 'BioBus' in col-01).

fields.name: org_kind
fields.verification: Verify against explicit institutional terms in the org name or self-description ('School of', 'Department', 'Libraries', 'Institute', 'Center', 'Co-Lab', 'Office of', 'collective', 'partners').

fields.name: contact_email
fields.verification: Match a unit-level contact email explicitly associated with the organization on the source page (e.g. 'cusp.education@nyu.edu', 'lib-reference@nyu.edu', 'zotero-help@library.columbia.edu').

fields.name: sources
fields.type: array<{url: string, source_tier: string, external_id: string | null}>
fields.verification: Confirm 'url' matches the cited source page and 'external_id' matches LiveWhale 'gid' or Bedework 'agrp_*'/'calsuite' identifier when present.

link_types.name: takes_place_at
link_types.meaning: The physical building or outdoor venue where an in-person event occurs (omitted for purely online events or pages that omit the venue).

link_types.name: hosted_by
link_types.meaning: The primary campus unit, library, institute, or group organizing the event.

link_types.name: co_presented_with
link_types.meaning: A collaborating organization, partner group, performing collective, related academic department, or publisher participating alongside the primary host.

link_types.name: part_of_org
link_types.meaning: A department, research center, branch library, or office belongs to a parent school or university library system.

link_types.name: based_at
link_types.meaning: An institute, center, or branch library occupies or operates out of a specific physical campus building.

source_tiers.name: official_structured_feed
source_tiers.trust_level: Highest for timestamps, timezones, persistent IDs, addresses, and structured access flags.
source_tiers.assignment_rule: Assign when the fact comes from a non-truncated typed field in an official central university json_feed (events.nyu.edu LiveWhale or events.columbia.edu Bedework), such as nyu-05, nyu-15, col-01, col-03, and col-05.

source_tiers.name: primary_host_html
source_tiers.trust_level: High for program descriptions, room details, featured people, and host-specific RSVP instructions; prefer over Tier 3 reposts.
source_tiers.assignment_rule: Assign when the fact comes from event metadata blocks or event-specific prose on a static_html page served from an official campus domain (*.nyu.edu, *.columbia.edu, nyu.libcal.com) whose site owner is the primary event host (nyu-01, nyu-02, nyu-04, nyu-07, nyu-10, nyu-12, nyu-14, nyu-17).

source_tiers.name: secondary_campus_repost_or_linked_platform
source_tiers.trust_level: Moderate; trusted when Tiers 1-2 are absent, but yields to Tiers 1-2 on schedule or venue conflicts, and detailed body schedules override summary widgets on the same page.
source_tiers.assignment_rule: Assign when a campus page cross-lists an event run by a different unit or venue (nyu-09 on LibCal pointing to CRACS Co-Lab; col-07 on cc-seas listing The Forum's market), when a date component such as year is inferred from the URL slug plus weekday agreement (nyu-02, nyu-17), or when RSVP details come from a campus-linked external ticketing page (Eventbrite in col-01, Luma in nyu-04).

source_tiers.name: untrusted_template_chrome_and_truncated_tails
source_tiers.trust_level: Zero; never extract standalone facts or override Tiers 1-3.
source_tiers.assignment_rule: Assign to CMS template boilerplate, blank registration form inputs/dropdowns (school lists in nyu-07, nyu-10), LibCal's hardcoded 'Please note this is an online event' footer on in-person pages (nyu-07, nyu-10, nyu-12), reused media filenames (Scaramucci filename in nyu-05), and cut-off trailing tokens in truncated feeds (col-03, col-05).

identity_rules.rule: Separate room/floor text into Event.location_detail first so multiple rooms resolve to one building (uniting Rm. 619 in nyu-07, Rm. 743 in nyu-10, and Rm. 745 in nyu-14 as 'Bobst Library'). Merge two Place records within the same university if they share (a) the same feed location_id (nyu-05, nyu-15), (b) the same normalized street number and street name ('370 Jay Street' and '370 Jay St' in nyu-04; '601 W. 125th St.' uniting 'The Lee C. Bollinger Forum' and 'The Forum at Columbia University' in col-07, while keeping '181 Mercer Street' in nyu-02 distinct from '196 Mercer Street' in nyu-09), or (c) an alias co-declared on an official page ('Dibner Library' and 'Bern Dibner Library' in nyu-12; 'International Affairs Building' and 'IAB' in col-05). Never create a Place for 'Online Online' (col-03).

Merge two Event records if they share the same LiveWhale 'id', LibCal numeric event ID, or Bedework ('guid', 'recurrenceId') pair. Across different platforms/URLs (such as events.columbia.edu + Eventbrite in col-01, or LibCal + primary host page in nyu-09), merge iff university matches, start_at overlaps within 15 minutes, resolved Place (or online modality) matches, and normalized core title/speaker matches. Keep repeating installments on different dates (weekly 'Meditations on Earth' in nyu-14, monthly 'Saturday Science' in col-01, repeated 'Introduction to Zotero' workshops in col-03, semesterly study breaks in nyu-10) as separate Event entities sharing only series_name; only bundle multiple dates into one Event.sessions array when a single production/market page explicitly lists those slots together (nyu-01, col-07).

Scope organization matching by university (leaving external partners unscoped). Merge records sharing a feed group ID ('gid' in LiveWhale; 'agrp_*'/'calsuite' in Bedework), or matching normalized names after stripping redundant parent prefixes ('Steinhardt Music and Performing Arts Professions' in nyu-15 == 'Music and Performing Arts Professions' under NYU Steinhardt in nyu-02), or matching parenthetical acronyms declared on official pages ('CUSP' in nyu-04, 'CRACS Co-Lab' in nyu-09, 'CUNO' in col-01). Keep sub-units distinct from parent schools/libraries via part_of_org rather than merging them.

decisions.choice: Keep people and event series as fields on Event rather than separate Person and EventSeries entity types
decisions.weighed: Promoting Person and EventSeries to full entity types vs storing featured_people, contact, and series_name on Event.
decisions.decision_and_why: Kept them as Event fields. Across all 15 samples, no speaker or performer appears in more than one event, staff organizers carry no rich attributes ('No Profile image'), and recurring series (nyu-04, nyu-14, col-01) have no standalone URLs or IDs. Keeping just Event, Place, and Organization keeps the graph small, checkable, and free of stub entities.

decisions.choice: Model Place at the building/venue level and keep rooms and virtual links on Event
decisions.weighed: Creating a Place entity per room or virtual link vs scoping Place to physical buildings/outdoor spaces and putting location_detail + modality on Event.
decisions.decision_and_why: Chose building-level Place plus Event.location_detail and Event.modality. Bobst Library hosts three different sample events in three different rooms (nyu-07, nyu-10, nyu-14); building-level Places avoid fragmenting campus landmarks and prevent bogus entities like 'Online Online' (col-03).

decisions.choice: Represent event timing as a non-empty sessions array with nullable end_at
decisions.weighed: Single start_at/end_at fields on Event vs separate Occurrence child entities vs an embedded sessions array on Event.
decisions.decision_and_why: Chose a sessions array on Event with nullable end_at. Thirteen samples have one slot (including nyu-15 with no end time), while nyu-01 (six play performances) and col-07 (six market afternoons) publish multiple slots on a single URL without per-slot pages.

decisions.choice: Add explicit access_scope ('public' vs 'host_university_only') while excluding all student-side state
decisions.weighed: Copying raw Bedework/LibCal audience tag lists vs distilling cross-campus eligibility into access_scope.
decisions.decision_and_why: Distilled eligibility into optional access_scope and stored zero student/twin interaction data. Because NYU and Columbia twins share this base, knowing whether an event welcomes outside students (nyu-04 via Luma, col-01, col-05) or requires a host NetID/UNI (nyu-12, col-03) prevents twins from recommending inaccessible events across campuses.

decisions.choice: Drop coordinates, thumbnails, and form-input metadata
decisions.weighed: Including lat/lon coordinates (nyu-05, nyu-15) and flyer thumbnails (nyu-05, nyu-15, col-01, col-05) vs dropping them.
decisions.decision_and_why: Dropped them. Coordinates appear in only 2 of 15 samples (below the 3-sample threshold), Bedework image paths are relative fragments, nyu-05's thumbnail filename references uninvolved speakers ('Anthony_Scaramucci__Manu_Meel'), and none help a low-token text twin verify facts.

uncertain.question: How to verify the calendar year when neither page text nor URL includes it (col-07).
uncertain.settling_evidence: Check whether raw HTML <meta>/JSON-LD tags or HTTP headers on cc-seas.columbia.edu carry the year before text extraction, and audit whether past years' events stay live at yearless URLs.

uncertain.question: Whether NYU LibCal's 'There are N seats available' (nyu-07, nyu-10, nyu-12) reports static room capacity or live remaining seats.
uncertain.settling_evidence: Fetch the same open LibCal event before and after a registration; if N decrements, capacity represents volatile remaining seats and needs either a fetched_at timestamp or separation from static max capacity (col-03).

uncertain.question: Whether the twins' static_html extractor can preserve anchor href URLs on action buttons without exceeding token budgets.
uncertain.settling_evidence: Measure token overhead of retaining hrefs on CTA anchors ('Get Tickets' in nyu-01, 'REGISTER' in nyu-02, 'RSVP on Luma' in nyu-04, 'linked here' in nyu-09), which would unlock missing registration links and nyu-01's missing theater location.

uncertain.question: Whether Columbia Bedework's public Zoom 'link' in col-03 bypasses or still enforces UNI-only registration.
uncertain.settling_evidence: Check events.columbia.edu's rendered page and Zoom SSO settings for X-BEDEWORK-UNI-ONLY-REG events to see if unregistered students can join directly or hit a registration gate.

uncertain.question: Whether truncated Bedework json_feed payloads (col-03, col-05) ever lose access restrictions or cancellations located after the cutoff.
uncertain.settling_evidence: Inspect full untruncated Bedework responses to confirm field ordering and adjust the fetcher to strip verbose xproperties aliases before token truncation.

misfits.why: In-person theatrical run of six performances that omits the physical venue/theater completely from the page text (likely hidden behind the stripped 'Get Tickets' or '.ics' link), leaving an in-person Event with no Place to link to.

Omits the year from both URL and body text, contradicts its own 'Event Date: 3 Dec to 4 Dec' header by listing three separate December weekends in prose, and is cross-listed on cc-seas.columbia.edu without naming a clear primary organizing unit for the market.

Contains a direct internal modality contradiction—labeled 'In-Person' at 'Bobst Library, 6th Floor, Rm. 619' at the top, yet states 'Please note this is an online event' above the LibCal registration form—and dumps dozens of blank form dropdown options into the page text.

Same LibCal template bug as nyu-07: an in-person finals study break serving pizza and snacks in Bobst Rm. 743 whose registration footer falsely claims 'Please note this is an online event', alongside a full school-dropdown dump.

Same LibCal registration footer claiming 'this is an online event' despite being an in-person pitch finale with refreshments in Dibner LC 400, plus dual building naming ('Dibner Library' vs 'Bern Dibner Library') on the same page.

Secondary repost on NYU Libraries' LibCal ('Type: NYU Press') for an event actually hosted by CRACS Co-Lab at IHDSC; leaves LibCal's structured Location field blank, buries the street address in prose, and loses its primary URL in 'linked here'.

Raw json_feed cuts off mid-token ('{"X-B'), sets location_address to 'Online Online', and exposes a live Zoom join URL in 'link' even though prose states Zoom details are sent only after UNI-restricted registration.

Raw json_feed truncates mid-tag at the end of xproperties ('.../Category/Economic'), requiring parser recovery and partial-tag rejection, and its UTC end timestamp crosses midnight to 2026-12-03 while local date stays 12/2/26.
